mentions.name: Cinekids
mentions.description: A web tool that scrapes reviews from parent-friendly movie review websites and aggregates them, used to vet whether a movie is appropriate before showing it to a young child.
mentions.problem: Checking whether a movie is appropriate before showing it to a young child
mentions.audience: The author, vetting movies before showing them to his 4-year-old child
mentions.source_excerpt: I still need to go back working on https://www.cinekids.info/ , a tool I made for myself to use before showing any movie to my 4 years old kiddo. It scrapes reviews from some parent friendly movie reviews websites and aggregates them.

evidence.value: I still need to go back working on https://www.cinekids.info/ , a tool I made for myself to use before showing any movie to my 4 years old kiddo. It scrapes reviews from some parent friendly movie reviews websites and aggregates them.
